CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_service_package_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
    insert into public.service_package_members (package_id, user_id, member_role)
    values (new.id, new.owner_id, 'owner')
    on conflict (package_id, user_id) do nothing;
    return new;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_set_student_verified(target_user_id uuid, verified boolean)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    current_admin_role text;
begin

    select role
    into current_admin_role
    from public.users
    where user_id = auth.uid();

    if current_admin_role is distinct from 'admin' then
        raise exception
            'Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.';
    end if;

    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.users
        where user_id = target_user_id
    ) then
        raise exception
            'Không tìm thấy tài khoản.';
    end if;

    if verified = true then

        update public.users
        set
            student_verified = true,
            verification_status = 'approved',
            verification_method = 'admin_grant',
            verified_by = auth.uid(),
            verified_at = now()
        where user_id = target_user_id;

    else

        update public.users
        set
            student_verified = false,
            verification_status = 'none',
            verification_method = 'none',
            verified_by = null,
            verified_at = null
        where user_id = target_user_id;

    end if;

    return json_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'verified', verified,
        'target_user_id', target_user_id
    );

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_order(p_order_id bigint)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare

    v_buyer_id uuid;
    v_status text;
    v_payment_method text;
    v_total numeric(14,2);

    v_wallet_id bigint;
    v_new_balance numeric(14,2);

    v_refund boolean := false;

    v_item record;

begin

    /* =====================================================
       1. LẤY VÀ KHÓA ĐƠN
    ===================================================== */

    select
        buyer_id,
        status,
        payment_method,
        total_amount

    into
        v_buyer_id,
        v_status,
        v_payment_method,
        v_total

    from public.orders

    where id = p_order_id

    for update;


    /* =====================================================
       2. KIỂM TRA
    ===================================================== */

    if v_buyer_id is null then
        raise exception 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.';
    end if;


    if v_buyer_id <> auth.uid() then
        raise exception 'Bạn không có quyền hủy đơn này.';
    end if;


    if v_status not in (
        'pending',
        'confirmed'
    ) then
        raise exception 'Đơn hàng hiện tại không thể hủy.';
    end if;


    /* =====================================================
       3. TRẢ LẠI TỒN KHO + HIỆN LẠI TIN BÁN
    ===================================================== */

    for v_item in

        select
            product_id,
            quantity

        from public.order_items

        where order_id = p_order_id

    loop

        update public.products

        set
            quantity =
                coalesce(quantity, 0)
                + v_item.quantity,

            status =
                'active',

            updated_at =
                now()

        where id =
            v_item.product_id;

    end loop;


    /* =====================================================
       4. HOÀN TIỀN NẾU THANH TOÁN ONLINE
    ===================================================== */

    if v_payment_method in (
        'iuh_wallet',
        'qr'
    ) then

        /* Tìm ví */

        select id

        into v_wallet_id

        from public.iuh_wallets

        where user_id = v_buyer_id

        for update;


        /* Nếu chưa có ví thì tạo */

        if v_wallet_id is null then

            insert into public.iuh_wallets (
                user_id,
                balance,
                pending,
                total_received
            )

            values (
                v_buyer_id,
                0,
                0,
                0
            )

            returning id
            into v_wallet_id;

        end if;


        /* Cộng tiền hoàn */

        update public.iuh_wallets

        set
            balance =
                balance + v_total,

            updated_at =
                now()

        where id =
            v_wallet_id

        returning balance
        into v_new_balance;


        /* Ghi giao dịch hoàn tiền */

        insert into public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description
        )

        values (
            v_wallet_id,
            v_buyer_id,
            'deposit',
            'Hoàn tiền đơn hàng',
            v_total,
            'Hoàn tiền do hủy đơn #' || p_order_id
        );


        v_refund := true;

    end if;


    /* =====================================================
       5. HỦY ĐƠN
    ===================================================== */

    update public.orders

    set
        status = 'cancelled',
        updated_at = now()

    where id = p_order_id;


    /* =====================================================
       6. LỊCH SỬ TRẠNG THÁI
    ===================================================== */

    insert into public.order_status_history (
        order_id,
        status,
        changed_by,
        note
    )

    values (
        p_order_id,
        'cancelled',
        auth.uid(),

        case

            when v_refund then
                'Hủy đơn - hoàn tiền vào IUH Wallet và hoàn lại sản phẩm'

            else
                'Hủy đơn - hoàn lại sản phẩm về tin bán'

        end
    );


    /* =====================================================
       7. KẾT QUẢ
    ===================================================== */

    return json_build_object(

        'success',
        true,

        'order_id',
        p_order_id,

        'cancelled',
        true,

        'refunded',
        v_refund,

        'refund_amount',
        case
            when v_refund
            then v_total
            else 0
        end,

        'new_wallet_balance',
        case
            when v_refund
            then v_new_balance
            else null
        end,

        'stock_restored',
        true

    );

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.users
        WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
          AND LOWER(role) = 'admin'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_seller(p_order_id bigint, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_items oi
        WHERE oi.order_id = p_order_id
          AND oi.seller_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

arguments: p_recipient_name text, p_recipient_phone text, p_recipient_address text, p_note text, p_shipping_method text, p_shipping_fee numeric, p_payment_method text, p_subtotal numeric, p_total_amount numeric, p_items jsonb, p_cart_ids bigint[]

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_order(p_recipient_name text, p_recipient_phone text, p_recipient_address text, p_note text, p_shipping_method text, p_shipping_fee numeric, p_payment_method text, p_subtotal numeric, p_total_amount numeric, p_items jsonb, p_cart_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

DECLARE

    v_user_id uuid;
    v_order_id bigint;
    v_order_code text;

    v_wallet_id bigint;
    v_balance numeric;

    v_item jsonb;
    v_product_quantity numeric;
    v_quantity numeric;

    /* =========================================
       XÁC ĐỊNH LOẠI ĐƠN
    ========================================= */

    v_is_consignment boolean := null;
    v_product_is_consignment boolean;


BEGIN

    /* =========================================
       USER ĐANG ĐĂNG NHẬP
    ========================================= */

    v_user_id := auth.uid();

    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Bạn chưa đăng nhập.';
    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       KIỂM TRA PHƯƠNG THỨC THANH TOÁN
    ========================================= */

    IF p_payment_method NOT IN (
        'qr',
        'iuh_wallet',
        'cash'
    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Phương thức thanh toán không hợp lệ.';

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       KIỂM TRA SẢN PHẨM
    ========================================= */

    IF jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Đơn hàng không có sản phẩm.';

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       KIỂM TRA + KHÓA TỒN KHO
       ĐỒNG THỜI XÁC ĐỊNH ĐƠN KÝ GỬI
    ========================================= */

    FOR v_item IN
        SELECT value
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    LOOP

        SELECT
            quantity,
            COALESCE(is_consignment, false)

        INTO
            v_product_quantity,
            v_product_is_consignment

        FROM public.products

        WHERE id =
            (v_item->>'product_id')::bigint

        FOR UPDATE;


        IF NOT FOUND THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Không tìm thấy sản phẩm.';

        END IF;


        /* =====================================
           KIỂM TRA TỒN KHO
        ===================================== */

        v_quantity :=
            (v_item->>'quantity')::numeric;


        IF v_product_quantity < v_quantity THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Sản phẩm không đủ tồn kho.';

        END IF;


        /* =====================================
           XÁC ĐỊNH LOẠI ĐƠN

           Sản phẩm đầu tiên quyết định loại đơn.
           Các sản phẩm sau phải cùng loại.

           TRUE  = ký gửi
           FALSE = bình thường
        ===================================== */

        IF v_is_consignment IS NULL THEN

            v_is_consignment :=
                v_product_is_consignment;

        ELSE

            IF v_is_consignment
                <> v_product_is_consignment THEN

                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Không thể mua sản phẩm thường và sản phẩm ký gửi trong cùng một đơn.';

            END IF;

        END IF;

    END LOOP;


    /* =========================================
       TRỪ TIỀN VÍ NGƯỜI MUA
    ========================================= */

    IF p_payment_method = 'iuh_wallet' THEN

        SELECT
            id,
            balance

        INTO
            v_wallet_id,
            v_balance

        FROM public.iuh_wallets

        WHERE user_id = v_user_id

        FOR UPDATE;


        IF v_wallet_id IS NULL THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Ví IUH chưa được thiết lập.';

        END IF;


        IF v_balance < p_total_amount THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Số dư Ví IUH không đủ.';

        END IF;


        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

        SET
            balance =
                balance - p_total_amount,

            updated_at =
                now()

        WHERE id = v_wallet_id;


        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description
        )

        VALUES (
            v_wallet_id,
            v_user_id,
            'payment',
            'Thanh toán đơn hàng',

            p_total_amount,

            CASE
                WHEN v_is_consignment = true
                THEN 'Thanh toán đơn hàng ký gửi IUH SHOP'
                ELSE 'Thanh toán đơn hàng IUH SHOP'
            END
        );

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       TẠO MÃ ĐƠN
    ========================================= */

    v_order_code :=
        'IUH' ||
        to_char(
            now(),
            'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
        ) ||
        lpad(
            floor(random() * 1000)::text,
            3,
            '0'
        );


    /* =========================================
       TẠO ORDERS

       TRUE  → consignment
       FALSE → normal
    ========================================= */

    INSERT INTO public.orders (
        order_code,
        buyer_id,
        recipient_name,
        recipient_phone,
        recipient_address,
        note,
        shipping_method,
        shipping_fee,
        payment_method,
        subtotal,
        total_amount,
        order_type,
        status
    )

    VALUES (
        v_order_code,
        v_user_id,
        p_recipient_name,
        p_recipient_phone,
        p_recipient_address,
        p_note,
        p_shipping_method,
        p_shipping_fee,
        p_payment_method,
        p_subtotal,
        p_total_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment = true
            THEN 'consignment'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'pending'
    )

    RETURNING id
    INTO v_order_id;


    /* =========================================
       TẠO ORDER ITEMS
    ========================================= */

    FOR v_item IN
        SELECT value
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    LOOP

        INSERT INTO public.order_items (
            order_id,
            product_id,
            seller_id,
            product_name,
            product_image,
            price,
            quantity,
            subtotal
        )

        VALUES (
            v_order_id,

            (v_item->>'product_id')::bigint,

            (v_item->>'seller_id')::uuid,

            v_item->>'product_name',

            v_item->>'product_image',

            (v_item->>'price')::numeric,

            (v_item->>'quantity')::integer,

            (v_item->>'subtotal')::numeric
        );


        /* =====================================
           TRỪ TỒN KHO
        ===================================== */

        UPDATE public.products

        SET
            quantity =
                quantity -
                (v_item->>'quantity')::numeric,

            status =
                CASE
                    WHEN quantity -
                        (v_item->>'quantity')::numeric <= 0
                    THEN 'deleted'
                    ELSE 'active'
                END,

            updated_at =
                now()

        WHERE id =
            (v_item->>'product_id')::bigint;

    END LOOP;


    /* =========================================
       XÓA KHỎI GIỎ
    ========================================= */

    IF p_cart_ids IS NOT NULL
       AND array_length(p_cart_ids, 1) > 0 THEN

        DELETE FROM public.cart_items

        WHERE id = ANY(p_cart_ids)

        AND user_id = v_user_id;

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       LỊCH SỬ TRẠNG THÁI
    ========================================= */

    INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (
        order_id,
        status,
        changed_by,
        note
    )

    VALUES (
        v_order_id,
        'pending',
        v_user_id,

        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment = true
            THEN 'Đơn hàng ký gửi được tạo thành công.'
            ELSE 'Đơn hàng được tạo thành công.'
        END
    );


    /* =========================================
       TRẢ KẾT QUẢ
    ========================================= */

    RETURN json_build_object(

        'success',
        true,

        'order_id',
        v_order_id,

        'order_code',
        v_order_code,

        'status',
        'pending',

        'order_type',

        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment = true
            THEN 'consignment'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'total_amount',
        p_total_amount

    );

END;

$function$

arguments: p_amount numeric, p_donor_name text, p_bank_name text, p_transfer_content text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deposit_iuh_wallet(p_amount numeric, p_bank text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_wallet public.iuh_wallets;
    v_balance numeric;
begin

    if auth.uid() is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;


    if p_amount is null
       or p_amount < 1000 then

        raise exception
            'Số tiền nạp tối thiểu là 1.000đ.';

    end if;


    insert into public.iuh_wallets(user_id)
    values(auth.uid())

    on conflict(user_id)
    do nothing;


    select *
    into v_wallet

    from public.iuh_wallets

    where user_id = auth.uid()

    for update;


    v_balance =
        v_wallet.balance + p_amount;


    update public.iuh_wallets

    set
        balance = v_balance,
        updated_at = now()

    where id = v_wallet.id;


    insert into public.wallet_transactions(
        wallet_id,
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        amount,
        description,
        bank
    )

    values(
        v_wallet.id,
        auth.uid(),
        'deposit',
        'Nạp tiền từ ngân hàng',
        p_amount,
        'Nạp tiền mô phỏng',
        p_bank
    );


    return v_balance;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_orders()
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN

    RETURN QUERY

    SELECT
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', o.id,
            'order_code', o.order_code,
            'buyer_id', o.buyer_id,

            'recipient_name', o.recipient_name,
            'recipient_phone', o.recipient_phone,
            'recipient_address', o.recipient_address,
            'note', o.note,

            'shipping_method', o.shipping_method,
            'shipping_fee', o.shipping_fee,

            'payment_method', o.payment_method,

            'subtotal', o.subtotal,
            'total_amount', o.total_amount,

            'status', o.status,

            'created_at', o.created_at,
            'updated_at', o.updated_at,

            'order_items',
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', oi.id,
                            'order_id', oi.order_id,
                            'product_id', oi.product_id,
                            'seller_id', oi.seller_id,
                            'product_name', oi.product_name,
                            'product_image', oi.product_image,
                            'price', oi.price,
                            'quantity', oi.quantity,
                            'subtotal', oi.subtotal,
                            'created_at', oi.created_at
                        )
                        ORDER BY oi.id
                    )
                    FROM public.order_items oi
                    WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
        )

    FROM public.orders o

    WHERE
        o.buyer_id = auth.uid()

        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.order_items oi2
            WHERE
                oi2.order_id = o.id
                AND oi2.seller_id = auth.uid()
        )

    ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    insert into public.users (
        user_id,
        fullname,
        student_id,
        faculty,
        email,
        phone,
        created_at
    )
    values (
        new.id,
        new.raw_user_meta_data->>'fullname',
        new.raw_user_meta_data->>'student_id',
        new.raw_user_meta_data->>'faculty',
        new.email,
        new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
        now()
    );

    return new;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pay_order_to_admin(p_order_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE

    v_user_id uuid;

    v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;

    v_buyer_wallet public.iuh_wallets%ROWTYPE;

    v_admin_wallet public.iuh_wallets%ROWTYPE;

    v_admin_user_id uuid;

    v_total numeric;

    v_platform_fee numeric;

    v_intermediary_fee numeric;

BEGIN

    /* ==============================
       USER HIỆN TẠI
    ============================== */

    v_user_id := auth.uid();

    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bạn chưa đăng nhập.';
    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       LẤY ĐƠN + LOCK
    ============================== */

    SELECT *
    INTO v_order
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE id = p_order_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.';
    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       CHỈ BUYER ĐƯỢC THANH TOÁN
    ============================== */

    IF v_order.buyer_id <> v_user_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Bạn không có quyền thanh toán đơn này.';
    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       KIỂM TRA ONLINE
    ============================== */

    IF v_order.payment_method NOT IN (
        'iuh_wallet',
        'qr'
    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Đơn này không phải thanh toán online.';

    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       CHỐNG THANH TOÁN 2 LẦN
    ============================== */

    IF COALESCE(
        v_order.payment_status,
        'unpaid'
    ) = 'paid' THEN

        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', true,
            'already_paid', true,
            'order_id', v_order.id
        );

    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       TỔNG TIỀN KHÁCH THANH TOÁN
    ============================== */

    v_total :=
        COALESCE(
            v_order.total_amount,
            0
        );


    IF v_total <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Tổng tiền đơn hàng không hợp lệ.';
    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       TÍNH PHÍ
       
       subtotal trong orders hiện tại
       = giá người bán + phí sàn 5%

       Ví dụ:
       Giá người bán: 175.000
       Phí sàn:         8.750
       subtotal:      183.750

       Phí sàn =
       183.750 × 5 / 105
       = 8.750
    ============================== */

    v_platform_fee :=
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(v_order.subtotal, 0)
            * 5
            / 105
        );


    /* ==============================
       PHÍ TRUNG GIAN

       shipping_fee:
       0     = gặp trực tiếp
       5.000 = qua trung gian
    ============================== */

    v_intermediary_fee :=
        COALESCE(
            v_order.shipping_fee,
            0
        );


    /* ==============================
       TÌM ADMIN
    ============================== */

    SELECT
        u.user_id
    INTO
        v_admin_user_id
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE LOWER(
        COALESCE(
            u.role,
            ''
        )
    ) = 'admin'
    ORDER BY u.user_id
    LIMIT 1;


    IF v_admin_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Chưa có tài khoản Admin.';
    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       LẤY VÍ ADMIN + LOCK
    ============================== */

    SELECT *
    INTO v_admin_wallet
    FROM public.iuh_wallets
    WHERE user_id = v_admin_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Admin chưa có IUH Wallet.';
    END IF;


    /* =================================================
       THANH TOÁN BẰNG IUH WALLET
    ================================================= */

    IF v_order.payment_method = 'iuh_wallet' THEN

        SELECT *
        INTO v_buyer_wallet
        FROM public.iuh_wallets
        WHERE user_id = v_user_id
        FOR UPDATE;


        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Bạn chưa có IUH Wallet.';
        END IF;


        IF COALESCE(
            v_buyer_wallet.balance,
            0
        ) < v_total THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Số dư IUH Wallet không đủ.';

        END IF;


        /* ==============================
           TRỪ TIỀN KHÁCH
        ============================== */

        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets
        SET
            balance =
                balance - v_total,

            updated_at =
                now()

        WHERE id =
            v_buyer_wallet.id;


        /* ==============================
           GHI GIAO DỊCH KHÁCH
        ============================== */

        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )
        VALUES (
            v_buyer_wallet.id,
            v_user_id,
            'payment',
            'Thanh toán đơn hàng',
            -v_total,
            'Thanh toán đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );

    END IF;


    /* =================================================
       CỘNG TOÀN BỘ TIỀN ĐƠN VÀO ADMIN
    ================================================= */

    UPDATE public.iuh_wallets
    SET
        balance =
            balance + v_total,

        updated_at =
            now()

    WHERE id =
        v_admin_wallet.id;


    /* ==============================
       GHI TIỀN GIỮ HỘ
    ============================== */

    INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
        wallet_id,
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        amount,
        description,
        created_at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_admin_wallet.id,
        v_admin_user_id,
        'sale',
        'Tiền giữ hộ đơn hàng',
        v_total,
        'Nhận tiền giữ hộ đơn ' ||
        COALESCE(
            v_order.order_code,
            v_order.id::text
        ),
        now()
    );


    /* =================================================
       GHI DOANH THU PHÍ SÀN
    ================================================= */

    IF v_platform_fee > 0 THEN

        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )
        VALUES (
            v_admin_wallet.id,
            v_admin_user_id,
            'fee',
            'Thu phí sàn',
            v_platform_fee,
            'Phí sàn 5% đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );

    END IF;


    /* =================================================
       GHI DOANH THU PHÍ TRUNG GIAN
    ================================================= */

    IF v_intermediary_fee > 0 THEN

        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )
        VALUES (
            v_admin_wallet.id,
            v_admin_user_id,
            'fee',
            'Phí trung gian',
            v_intermediary_fee,
            'Phí trung gian đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );

    END IF;


    /* ==============================
       ĐÁNH DẤU PAID
    ============================== */

    UPDATE public.orders
    SET
        payment_status = 'paid',

        paid_at = now(),

        updated_at = now()

    WHERE id = v_order.id;


    /* ==============================
       TRẢ KẾT QUẢ
    ============================== */

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(

        'success',
        true,

        'order_id',
        v_order.id,

        'order_code',
        v_order.order_code,

        'amount',
        v_total,

        'platform_fee',
        v_platform_fee,

        'intermediary_fee',
        v_intermediary_fee,

        'admin_user_id',
        v_admin_user_id

    );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.settle_online_order(p_order_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

DECLARE

    v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;

    v_admin_user_id uuid;
    v_admin_wallet public.iuh_wallets%ROWTYPE;

    v_recipient_wallet public.iuh_wallets%ROWTYPE;

    v_seller_id uuid;
    v_consignment_user_id uuid;

    v_seller_total numeric;
    v_seller_receive numeric;

    v_total_amount numeric := 0;
    v_total_admin_revenue numeric := 0;

    v_is_consignment boolean := false;

BEGIN

    /* =========================================
       1. LẤY ĐƠN
    ========================================= */

    SELECT *
    INTO v_order
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE id = p_order_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.';
    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       2. PHẢI HOÀN TẤT
    ========================================= */

    IF v_order.status <> 'completed' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Đơn hàng chưa hoàn tất.';
    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       3. CHỈ ONLINE
    ========================================= */

    IF v_order.payment_method NOT IN (
        'qr',
        'iuh_wallet'
    ) THEN

        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', true,
            'settled', false,
            'message', 'Đơn COD không cần giải ngân.'
        );

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       4. ĐÃ GIẢI NGÂN
    ========================================= */

    IF v_order.settled_at IS NOT NULL THEN

        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', true,
            'settled', false,
            'already_settled', true
        );

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       5. KIỂM TRA LOẠI ĐƠN
    ========================================= */

    v_is_consignment :=
        LOWER(
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_type,
                'normal'
            )
        ) = 'consignment';


    /* =========================================
       6. TÌM ADMIN
    ========================================= */

    SELECT user_id
    INTO v_admin_user_id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE LOWER(role) = 'admin'
    LIMIT 1;


    IF v_admin_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không tìm thấy tài khoản Admin.';
    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       7. VÍ ADMIN
    ========================================= */

    SELECT *
    INTO v_admin_wallet
    FROM public.iuh_wallets
    WHERE user_id = v_admin_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ví Admin chưa tồn tại.';
    END IF;


    /* =====================================================
       8. ĐƠN KÝ GỬI
       
       90% → người gửi
       10% → Admin
    ===================================================== */

    IF v_is_consignment THEN

        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    COALESCE(
                        oi.subtotal,
                        oi.price * oi.quantity
                    )
                ),
                0
            )
        INTO v_total_amount

        FROM public.order_items oi

        WHERE oi.order_id = v_order.id;


        v_total_admin_revenue :=
            ROUND(
                v_total_amount * 0.10,
                0
            );


        /* =====================================
           TÌM NGƯỜI GỬI
        ===================================== */

        SELECT cr.user_id
        INTO v_consignment_user_id

        FROM public.order_items oi

        JOIN public.products p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id

        JOIN public.consignment_requests cr
            ON cr.id = p.consignment_request_id

        WHERE oi.order_id = v_order.id
          AND p.is_consignment = true
          AND p.consignment_request_id IS NOT NULL

        LIMIT 1;


        IF v_consignment_user_id IS NULL THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Không tìm thấy người gửi của sản phẩm ký gửi.';

        END IF;


        /* =====================================
           NGƯỜI GỬI NHẬN 90%
        ===================================== */

        v_seller_receive :=
            ROUND(
                v_total_amount * 0.90,
                0
            );


        /* =====================================
           LẤY VÍ NGƯỜI GỬI
        ===================================== */

        SELECT *
        INTO v_recipient_wallet

        FROM public.iuh_wallets

        WHERE user_id = v_consignment_user_id

        FOR UPDATE;


        IF NOT FOUND THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Người gửi chưa có IUH Wallet.';

        END IF;


        /* =====================================
           ADMIN TRỪ 90%
        ===================================== */

        IF COALESCE(v_admin_wallet.balance, 0)
            < v_seller_receive
        THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Ví Admin không đủ tiền để giải ngân.';

        END IF;


        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

        SET
            balance =
                COALESCE(balance, 0)
                - v_seller_receive,

            updated_at = now()

        WHERE id = v_admin_wallet.id;


        /* =====================================
           ADMIN TRANSACTION
        ===================================== */

        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )

        VALUES (
            v_admin_wallet.id,
            v_admin_user_id,
            'payment',
            'Giải ngân ký gửi',
            v_seller_receive,
            'Giải ngân 90% đơn ký gửi ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );


        /* =====================================
           CỘNG 90% CHO NGƯỜI GỬI
        ===================================== */

        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

        SET
            balance =
                COALESCE(balance, 0)
                + v_seller_receive,

            total_received =
                COALESCE(total_received, 0)
                + v_seller_receive,

            updated_at = now()

        WHERE id = v_recipient_wallet.id;


        /* =====================================
           TRANSACTION NGƯỜI GỬI
        ===================================== */

        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )

        VALUES (
            v_recipient_wallet.id,
            v_consignment_user_id,
            'sale',
            'Tiền bán hàng ký gửi',
            v_seller_receive,
            'Nhận 90% tiền bán sản phẩm ký gửi đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );


        /* =====================================
           ADMIN NHẬN 10% PHÍ KÝ GỬI
        ===================================== */

        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

        SET
            balance =
                COALESCE(balance, 0)
                + v_total_admin_revenue,

            updated_at = now()

        WHERE id = v_admin_wallet.id;


        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )

        VALUES (
            v_admin_wallet.id,
            v_admin_user_id,
            'fee',
            'Phí ký gửi',
            v_total_admin_revenue,
            'Thu phí ký gửi 10% đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );


    /* =====================================================
       9. ĐƠN THƯỜNG
       
       Giữ nguyên:
       Seller nhận 100%
    ===================================================== */

    ELSE

        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    COALESCE(
                        oi.subtotal,
                        oi.price * oi.quantity
                    )
                ),
                0
            )

        INTO v_total_amount

        FROM public.order_items oi

        WHERE oi.order_id = v_order.id;


        IF COALESCE(v_admin_wallet.balance, 0)
            < v_total_amount
        THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Ví Admin không đủ tiền để giải ngân.';

        END IF;


        /* =====================================
           TRỪ ADMIN
        ===================================== */

        UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

        SET
            balance =
                COALESCE(balance, 0)
                - v_total_amount,

            updated_at = now()

        WHERE id = v_admin_wallet.id;


        INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
            wallet_id,
            user_id,
            type,
            title,
            amount,
            description,
            created_at
        )

        VALUES (
            v_admin_wallet.id,
            v_admin_user_id,
            'payment',
            'Giải ngân cho người bán',
            v_total_amount,
            'Giải ngân đơn ' ||
            COALESCE(
                v_order.order_code,
                v_order.id::text
            ),
            now()
        );


        /* =====================================
           TỪNG SELLER
        ===================================== */

        FOR v_seller_id IN

            SELECT DISTINCT seller_id

            FROM public.order_items

            WHERE
                order_id = v_order.id
                AND seller_id IS NOT NULL

        LOOP

            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    SUM(
                        COALESCE(
                            subtotal,
                            price * quantity
                        )
                    ),
                    0
                )

            INTO v_seller_total

            FROM public.order_items

            WHERE
                order_id = v_order.id
                AND seller_id = v_seller_id;


            IF v_seller_total <= 0 THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;


            v_seller_receive :=
                ROUND(
                    v_seller_total,
                    0
                );


            SELECT *
            INTO v_recipient_wallet

            FROM public.iuh_wallets

            WHERE user_id = v_seller_id

            FOR UPDATE;


            IF NOT FOUND THEN

                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Người bán chưa có IUH Wallet.';

            END IF;


            UPDATE public.iuh_wallets

            SET
                balance =
                    COALESCE(balance, 0)
                    + v_seller_receive,

                total_received =
                    COALESCE(total_received, 0)
                    + v_seller_receive,

                updated_at = now()

            WHERE id = v_recipient_wallet.id;


            INSERT INTO public.wallet_transactions (
                wallet_id,
                user_id,
                type,
                title,
                amount,
                description,
                created_at
            )

            VALUES (
                v_recipient_wallet.id,
                v_seller_id,
                'sale',
                'Tiền bán hàng',
                v_seller_receive,
                'Nhận tiền bán hàng đơn ' ||
                COALESCE(
                    v_order.order_code,
                    v_order.id::text
                ),
                now()
            );

        END LOOP;

    END IF;


    /* =========================================
       10. ĐÁNH DẤU ĐÃ GIẢI NGÂN
    ========================================= */

    UPDATE public.orders

    SET
        settled_at = now(),
        updated_at = now()

    WHERE id = v_order.id;


    /* =========================================
       11. KẾT QUẢ
    ========================================= */

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(

        'success',
        true,

        'settled',
        true,

        'order_id',
        v_order.id,

        'order_code',
        v_order.order_code,

        'order_type',
        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment
                THEN 'consignment'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'seller_receive',

        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment
                THEN v_seller_receive
            ELSE v_total_amount
        END,

        'admin_revenue',

        CASE
            WHEN v_is_consignment
                THEN v_total_admin_revenue
            ELSE 0
        END

    );

END;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_consignment_on_order_completed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN

    IF NEW.status = 'completed'
       AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
    THEN

        UPDATE public.consignment_requests cr
        SET
            status = 'completed',
            updated_at = now()
        FROM public.products p
        JOIN public.order_items oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        WHERE oi.order_id = NEW.id
          AND p.is_consignment = true
          AND p.consignment_request_id = cr.id;

    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_consignment_on_order_item()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_product record;
BEGIN

    SELECT
        p.is_consignment,
        p.consignment_request_id
    INTO v_product
    FROM public.products p
    WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;

    IF COALESCE(v_product.is_consignment, false) = true
       AND v_product.consignment_request_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN

        UPDATE public.consignment_requests
        SET
            status = 'sold',
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_product.consignment_request_id
          AND status IN ('approved', 'selling');

    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.withdraw_iuh_wallet(p_amount numeric, p_bank text, p_account text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_wallet public.iuh_wallets;
    v_balance numeric;
begin

    if auth.uid() is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;


    if p_amount is null
       or p_amount < 1000 then

        raise exception
            'Số tiền rút tối thiểu là 1.000đ.';

    end if;


    if coalesce(trim(p_account),'') = '' then

        raise exception
            'Vui lòng nhập số tài khoản.';

    end if;


    insert into public.iuh_wallets(user_id)
    values(auth.uid())

    on conflict(user_id)
    do nothing;


    select *
    into v_wallet

    from public.iuh_wallets

    where user_id = auth.uid()

    for update;


    if v_wallet.balance < p_amount then

        raise exception
            'Số dư khả dụng không đủ.';

    end if;


    v_balance =
        v_wallet.balance - p_amount;


    update public.iuh_wallets

    set
        balance = v_balance,
        updated_at = now()

    where id = v_wallet.id;


    insert into public.wallet_transactions(
        wallet_id,
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        amount,
        description,
        bank,
        account
    )

    values(
        v_wallet.id,
        auth.uid(),
        'withdraw',
        'Rút tiền về ngân hàng',
        p_amount,
        'Rút tiền mô phỏng',
        p_bank,
        p_account
    );


    return v_balance;

end;
$function$
